message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic chills and modern scares you can binge‑watch this Friday:

| # | Title (Year) | Genre / Subgenre | Why it works |
|---|--------------|------------------|---------------|
| **1** | *The Shining* (1980) | Psychological Horror/Surrealism | Iconic atmosphere + haunting score – perfect for creeping dread. |
| **2** | *Hereditary* (2018) | Family Trauma/Horror Thriller | Intense family drama fused with supernatural terror. |
| **3** | *Get Out* (2017) | Social Commentary/Satire | Smart social critique wrapped in suspenseful twists. |
| **4** | *A Quiet Place* (2018) | Survival Horror | Silence as tension generator—great for an adrenaline rush. |
| **5** | *Midsommar* (2019) | Folk Horror | Daylight horrors make the film uniquely unsettling. |
| **6** | *It Follows* (2014) | Urban Legend | Simple premise but delivers relentless paranoia. |
| **7** | *Suspiria* (1977) | Gothic Terror | Classic Italian style with striking visuals & eerie soundtrack. |
| **8** | *The Babadook* (2014) | Psychological Drama | A metaphorical monster that feels deeply personal. |

Feel free to shuffle them into your own “horror marathon” order or pick one per movie night! Enjoy the fright fest.
